prompt_name: Tamil Nadu Diwali - Cinematic Cultural Portrait

subject.main_subject: A joyful Tamil family celebrating Diwali together
subject.people: A mother, father, and two daughters aged 13 and 11, with natural smiles and believable family interaction
subject.traditional_clothing: The mother wears a rich Kanchipuram silk saree; the father wears a crisp white veshti and traditional shirt; the daughters wear colourful silk pavadai-dhavani outfits
subject.cultural_details: Traditional brass kuthu vilakku, clay diyas, jasmine flowers, gold jewellery, and an intricate kolam decorated with flower petals
subject.expression_and_mood: Genuine happiness, warmth, family togetherness, and youthful excitement

setting.location: A traditional Tamil Nadu family home's entrance and courtyard
setting.environment: Terracotta flooring, a wooden doorway, mango-leaf toranam, marigold garlands, and rows of clay lamps
setting.cultural_context: A family gathering for Deepavali in Tamil Nadu, with regionally appropriate decorations and customs
setting.authenticity: Keep the clothing, home architecture, decorations, and family activities consistent with Tamil Nadu traditions

lighting.type: Warm diya light mixed with soft blue twilight
lighting.quality: Natural cinematic contrast, gentle highlights on silk and brass, realistic skin tones

camera.depth_of_field: Moderately shallow, with the family in sharp focus and lamps softly glowing in the background
camera.composition: Family centred naturally, diyas and kolam visible in the foreground, traditional doorway in the background
camera.quality: Photorealistic, high detail, natural anatomy, realistic fabric texture, cinematic composition

palette.color_grading: Rich festive colours with restrained saturation and natural skin tones

style.detail_level: Intricate silk weaving, authentic jewellery, realistic diya flames, detailed kolam patterns
style.overall_feeling: A premium festival film still celebrating Tamil heritage and family bonds

text_in_image.instruction: No text or lettering in the image

things_to_avoid: North Indian wedding attire or unrelated regional customs
Unrealistic temple structures in a residential courtyard
Excessive fireworks or dangerous fire near children
Distorted hands, duplicated people, artificial smiles
Plastic skin, oversaturated colours, garbled text, watermarks
final_instruction: Create a visually stunning but believable Tamil Nadu Deepavali celebration, emphasizing family warmth, authentic tradition, beautiful diya light, and cinematic storytelling.
